abilities.effect: The trap makes up to four dart Strikes against creatures standing on the seal, then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Dart Volley
abilities.trigger: More than two Small or larger creatures step on the brass seal.

hazard.description: Four dart-loaded pipes hidden in the diagonal walls are connected to a pressure plate under the brass seal in the room's center.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to disable the pressure plate, or four Thievery DC 18 (trained) checks to plug the dart launchers
hazard.hp_note: to destroy the seal and disable the trap
hazard.name: Dart Barrage
hazard.reset: The trap runs out of darts after 4 rounds of firing and must be reset manually by dismantling the walls to reload the launchers. If at any point there are no longer more than two creatures placing weight on the floor, the trap ceases firing but remains armed, ready to resume firing its remaining darts once triggered again.
hazard.routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action for each disabled launcher. On each of the trap's actions, it fires one dart at a creature in the center of the room.
